name: MCPMark
summary: Stress-testing benchmark for agentic models using real MCP environments (Notion, GitHub, Filesystem, Postgres, Playwright), with strict automated verifiers and sandboxed tasks.
description: One-command tasks, isolated sandboxes, auto-resume and aggregated reports. Since June 2026 the default task set is MCPMark Verified (version-pinned environments, stabilized verifiers); earlier results are not directly comparable. Trajectory logs are published on Hugging Face. Paper: arXiv 2509.24002.
